Good evening planning crew,
Measured month behind us, one thing is left: water bowls

I am writing with thanks for the steady care shown across the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Our work remains centered on calm handling, patient coordination, and close attention to comfort from booking through pickup. Where a crate review is needed, please follow the usual welfare checks and keep the tone reassuring for travelers and handlers alike.

Please remember that each animal must be assessed with care before acceptance, and that any special comfort request should be passed along without delay. <<FACT F064>> This helps us keep rabbit arrangements safe, consistent, and fully aligned with our internal standards. For small dog bookings, <<FACT F056>> and the related notes should be entered clearly so the team can proceed without confusion.

Thank you for maintaining a steady hand, a careful voice, and a humane approach in every case. These routines support the traveler, protect the animal, and make our service more dependable for everyone involved. Please continue to share any concerns promptly so they can be addressed before the next handoff.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
